I, Micheál Martin, Minister for Education and Science, in exercise of the powers conferred on me by section 2 (1) (as amended by the Local Government Act, 1998 (No. 16 of 1998)) of the Local Authorities (Officers and Employees) Act. 1926 (No. 39 of 1926), with the concurrence of the Local Appointments Commissioners, hereby order as follows:

1.       This Order may be cited as the Local Authorities (Officers and Employees) Act, 1926 (Declaration of Offices) (No. 2) Order, 1999.

2.       The office of chief executive officer of a vocational education committee referred to in section 23 of the Vocational Education Act, 1930 (No. 29 of 1930), is hereby declared to be an office to which the Local Authorities (Officers and Employees) Act, 1926 (No. 39 of 1926), applies.

GIVEN under my Official Seal,

this 27 day of 10th_________, 1999.

Micheál Martin,

Minister for Education and Science

The Local Appointments Commissioners concur in the making of this Order

S Pattison

J O'Dwyer

JP Farrelly

Local Appointments Commissioners

Dated this 11 day of January 2000
